hero.title: Design with intent. Build with precision.
hero.subtitle: I'm a multidisciplinary creative who turns bold ideas into sharp, functional digital products.

paragraphs.0: I started out sketching interfaces on napkins and never really stopped. Over the past eight years, that habit grew into a full practice spanning product design, front-end development, and brand systems for startups and established companies alike.
paragraphs.1: I care about the details most people skip past: the easing curve on a hover state, the contrast ratio that makes text actually readable, the empty state that still feels considered. Bold doesn't mean loud — it means every decision is deliberate.
paragraphs.2: These days I split my time between client case studies and personal experiments, always looking for the next constraint worth breaking.
